scope: UI evidence packaging only; no production files changed and no tests rerun during packaging.

actualVisualInspection.method: The three original PNG files were opened with view_image and visually inspected. The remaining nine PNGs were not visually inspected. All twelve observations have automated DOM/layout assertions in browser.json.

evidenceCopy.method: Byte-for-byte copy2 of the existing browser report and all 12 PNGs; no report content or screenshots changed.

limitations: Actual Chrome renders the current editor over local HTTP. Build status GET/cancel responses are synthetic browser fixtures, not Godot or Bevy execution.
